The walkthrough shows how Governed RAG works. You can follow one request, step by step, from the question to the checked reply. The step that uses the language model comes after code and data built for this subject, and before the code that checks the language model's output.

Before the language model, code is used for the filters, the routing, reading the parameters from the question, finding the passages, supplying the figures and filling the template part. After it, code is used to check the explanation, record each step in the trace and count the tokens.

Demonstrator note: in this demonstration version, the licence filter has two use modes. In a full-scale production version, the access rights in each user's contract would be checked each time passages are found.

Demonstrator note: direction words are banned from the explanation, because the checks in this demonstration version cannot test them reliably. In a full-scale production version, the direction check would have a measured error rate and a review of each dropped explanation.

Demonstrator note: this demonstration version covers the economies, passages and questions counted above, for one user on a laptop. In a full-scale production version, the catalogue would hold thousands of series and every document that could answer a question, for many users.

Demonstrator note: in this demonstration version, one person writes each definition and rating reason as the vertical domain expert and checks it as the horizontal domain expert. In a full-scale production version, each definition and rating reason would have a named owner in the team that produces the data, and a different person would check it.
